claim: A choice question reads its keys, not their descriptions: whatever the planner should weigh about a card must be in the key, which is why the bot writes card notes there.
evidence: Tests before the loop: replayed picks did not change at all when a note was added to the description; Laya took a new weapon in 4 of 6 offers once the key said so.

claim: The decision models judge one concrete option at a time better than they rank many at once, so each goal and each move is its own question.
evidence: Tests before the loop, on replayed states; the bot is built around it.

claim: Words beat numbers: describing a move's cost as 'Tibo would get badly hurt' picks the least damaging move far more often than a percentage.
evidence: Tests before the loop, Laya on 50 replayed states.

claim: A danger rating tracks how many threats a description lists, not which ones, so a fatal move with a short description can rate safest.
evidence: Tests before the loop; hot oil example.

claim: A 0-4 hurt score per move finds the least damaging move more reliably than a yes/no danger question.
evidence: Tests before the loop, Jev on replayed Nightmare steps: 98-100% with the score.

claim: The decision models weigh the start of a text most: what matters goes first.
evidence: Directive-first runs follow chest rule when listed (E21, 17-18-06). 17-20-20 again opened chests once listed and did not evade. 17-44-47 followed the whetstone ban, the first rule, on all six listings, and opened chests inside 80 units. The later food line lost five votes, all at 210 units or more, so line position and distance are both in play.

claim: On the Nightmare Daily, crowds barely hurt a Tibo that keeps moving; nearly all damage comes from hot oil and bosses.
With no directive, the planner evades through the early minute and then collects gems, and a boss on screen usually does not replace that goal.
evidence: E19 refuted open-world evade-only; daily differs.

claim: The default pick question favours upgrading a card already held and never takes Reroll or Skip, yet it still completed five recipes in one run.
evidence: Multiple world runs; 17-18-06 took many Skips late at high level but evolved five weapons without forced Skip plan. 17-20-20 evolved five weapons by 8:16 and never took Reroll (on offer from 3:34). Skip won at 10:13 twice, 11:59 twice, 13:34 and 14:02, each time against Sack of Gold and Baked Potato at high hp. Baked Potato won at 12:31 (hp 96), 12:56 (hp 110), 13:16 (hp 116), 14:02 (hp 103) and 14:26 (hp 84). The never-Skip half is what this run contradicts. 17-44-47 took Root Spikes and Masher Grip upgrades, new Big Bowl and Mash Wave, and Reroll lost at 1:38 (6%), 2:08 (4%) and 2:49 (4%). No Skip was on offer, and no recipe completed.

claim: Health rises about 25 to 30 with no food goal on the row, and those rises are why a long low plateau and a boss chunk did not end this run. The source is not in the log.
evidence: Daily E1 jumps; 17-18-06 gained ~384 total with mixed food/regen (outcome). 17-20-20 outcome health gained about 1033, source unnamed. See B37 for the row-level jumps. 17-44-47 gained about 58: +24 at 2:45 (34 to 58) and +30 at 2:48 (58 to 88), plus 4 on the death row, source still unnamed.

claim: A finished food goal heals about 30 when no boss hit lands in the same seconds.
evidence: E1 food rows; 17-18-06 food at 2:28, 7:33, 13:02, 16:20. 17-27-39 food 3:11 64→94. 17-20-20 food at 12:38 healed 131 to 162 (+31). The 14:37 food ended at +7 with ice-imp 23.1 on the hurt list.

claim: Compost Titan and Ketchup Kraken hit for tens of hp from 140 or more away, and the one-second forecast does not price those hits, so an evade goal does not stop them.
evidence: Daily E1; 17-18-06 died 17:14 with boss:compost-titan 6.1 at low hp.

claim: At extraDamage 0.02, standing still on a charging chest is removed when the forecast costs more than about 3 hp, so a prompt cannot finish that channel and the fail text can blame gold while gold is plentiful.
evidence: E1, E21, 17-03-58 failures; many successful opens after step-off in 17-18-06. 17-20-20 stepped off chests at 1:38 (0.7 of 1) and 3:12-3:24 (0.4 to 0.7 of 1). C65563 failed at 1:19, no closer for 6 seconds. Several later channels still opened, including Factory Reset at 1:38 and Loaded Dice at 3:21. 17-44-47 opened both chests (1:40 and 1:41) without a step-off failure. A Crop Patch at 1:22 failed the same way: no closer for 6 seconds, stepped off twice.

claim: On this seed, evading every boss spends cheap minutes: Grater Golem cost 16 hp, and The Masher, Sir Strawman, The Great Wireworm and The Mandoline left no damage in the outcome.
evidence: Daily E1 only.

claim: On nightmare open world, trash mobs inside 60 units are the listed damage, and a baseline run can die from that contact while hazards and bosses have no damage line.
evidence: E19, E21; 17-18-06 long run. 17-27-39: ketchup-drop 26, tomato-leech 26, potato-beetle 15. 17-20-20 ice-imp 773 of 1179 is the death, and the 34, 87 and 114 hp ticks at 10:56, 13:47 and 14:19 are page walks with enemies_near 0. Bosses also have lines (mandoline 146, wireworm 75, late-blight 58) and hot oil 55. The inside-60 mechanism is what this run puts in doubt. 17-44-47 death at 3:44 had enemies_near 24 on the killing step: sizzle-imp 66, crumb-ant 21, bowling-ball 10, fry-fly 10, bog-slime 9, plus amusing 26, hot oil 20 and queen 8, 170 in all. This death matches contact trash. The enemies_near 0 ticks stay the open half.

claim: With no directive on nightmare open world, the planner keeps evading while enemies are within 60, and gems, food and chests lose that vote through death.
evidence: E19; directive runs 0 evade.

claim: On nightmare open world the one-second forecast calls crowd steps free while those steps still take several hp, so the safest-looking move is where the crowd damage lands.
evidence: E20 on three seeds including late 17-18-06 grease/ice contact. 17-20-20 page walks the forecast priced as free: ice-imp 33.8 at 10:56, 87.1 at 13:47, 113.7 at 14:19, all with enemies_near 0; mandoline 63.6 at 12:18 from 273 away and 82.3 at 12:27 from 132 away. 17-44-47 page-walked up through hot oil at 0:48 (forecast free, oil 7.6 to 11.7, health 110 to 102) and at 3:43 took the only step not priced as death, forecast -3 hp, for sizzle-imp 22.1 with 24 enemies within 60.

claim: The unexplained heal of about 25 to 30 hp did not happen in either nightmare open-world run in the first three minutes, while health fell from 120 to 1.
evidence: Short E19/E21 runs; 17-03 had 51→81 at 3:14; 17-27 total hp_gained ~67 with food at 3:11. Refuted on 17-20-20: +24 at 1:37 (67 to 91) and +29 at 1:38 (87 to 116), max hp still 120, no food goal. 17-44-47 adds +24 at 2:45 (34 to 58) and +30 at 2:48 (58 to 88), max hp still 120, no food goal.

claim: A finished Spud Freezer is a short channel, and its freeze line matches a drop in enemies_near.
evidence: E19 freezer use. 17-20-20 charged a Spud Freezer at 6:31 (39 away) and finished it at 6:34.

claim: On nightmare open world, amusing and Colorado Queen often appear around 2:00 and 3:00; amusing sometimes puts damage on the outcome list and queen often tops trash-plus-boss chunks on short runs.
evidence: 17-27-39: amusing 12, queen 25 of 140; E23 varied by seed. 17-20-20: amusing at 2:00 and Colorado Queen at 3:03, neither on the outcome list (ice-imp 773, mandoline 146, wireworm 75, late-blight 58, hot oil 55). 17-44-47: amusing at 2:00 for 26, Colorado Queen at 3:00 for 8. Sizzle-imp 66 topped this short run, so the queen was a small line here.

claim: A plain directive in planner.state moves the goal vote: naming 'open a listed chest' put chest goals on top and removed evade, but it does not override distance or low health.
evidence: E21, 17-03-58, 17-18-06 (many chest chains to 17:14). 17-27 Open chest 77% at 2:20. 17-20-20: 0 evade goals, about 32 chest opens once listed, including a chest 342 away opened from 11:15 to 11:22 at full hp. At 15:03, hp 48/192, the planner chose food about 100 away. 17-44-47 opened a chest 77 away at 77% (82 hp, 1:37) and the next at 22 away at 61% (1:40). A chest 138 away at 63 hp scored 35% and lost to explore at 43% (3:08). Chests at 307, 376 and 510 scored 23%, 18% and 17%.

claim: The planner scores a chest goal lower the farther the chest is and the lower Tibo's health is, so at low health or beyond about 120 units it prefers explore even with a directive to open chests.
evidence: E21 distance/hp scores; 17-18-06 still opened distant chests once strong. 17-20-20 opened a chest 342 away at 11:15-11:22 at 192/192, and other chests at 141, 155, 165 and 173. The low-hp far-chest case was not clean: at 48 hp the planner chose food. 17-44-47 won the chest vote at 77 units and 82 hp (77%) and lost it at 138 units and 63 hp (35% against explore 43%). One mid-health sample on the far side of 120. The full-hp far-chest case is still the contradicting one.

claim: Bog Toad (a charger) is the largest damage source on nightmare open world and the one-second forecast does not price its dash, so steps rated free next to it lose 7 to 14 hp.
evidence: E21 bog-toad 44; absent on 17-03 and 17-18-06 seeds. Absent on 17-20-20 (seed 127B4T9): no bog-toad line in 1179 damage. Largest source was ice-imp 773.

claim: With the default action.dash question the dash charge is almost never used, even in crowds, and it recharges within about 5.5 seconds.
evidence: E21 one dash; E24 template on 17-03 and 17-18-06 with many dashes (18 on 17-18-06 log).

claim: On nightmare open world the first chest is not listed until about 1:30 or later, because chests must be discovered and Potato Crates cost gold Tibo does not have, so a chest directive cannot act earlier.
evidence: E21 1:32; E19 2:16; 17-18-06 first chest 1:46; 17-27 first listed 2:20 seed Y9N9T2, all at exploreDistance 300. 17-20-20 at exploreDistance 600, seed 127B4T9, listed chests at 1:08, 40 and 54 away, hp 108/120, and opened them. One seed, so the 1:30 floor may be the 300 knob. 17-44-47 at exploreDistance 300, seed Z40504, found the first chest at 1:37, 77 away, hp 82. Another 300-knob sample.

claim: Bosses come on the clock: amusing at 2:00 and Colorado Queen at about 3:00, in every run so far.
evidence: Daily E1; three world seeds including 17-18-06; 17-27 amusing 2:00 queen 3:00. 17-20-20: amusing at 2:00, Colorado Queen at 3:03, then The Masher 4:00, Late Blight 6:01, Sir Strawman 7:00, The Fryer King 8:00, The Great Wireworm 10:02, The Mandoline 12:05, The Deep Freezer 14:02. 17-44-47: amusing at 2:00, Colorado Queen at 3:00.

claim: When no food or chest is near, the planner explores at hp under 20%, because 'keep away from enemies' stays a few points under explore.
evidence: E21 hp 17-9; 17-18-06 no sub-20% stretch without chests. 17-20-20 had no stretch under 20% until the death second, when food was listed and the planner chose it at 48/192.

claim: A dash question that says yes at 5 enemies within 60, or at 5 hp in the last 3 seconds, spends the charge when the action model is asked and a condition holds.
evidence: 17-03-58 ~12 spends; 17-18-06 18 dashed rows; 17-27 multiple dashed rows with logged probabilities. 17-20-20 dashed at 78% and 96% during the 1:14-1:20 chest approach, and at 85-88% on Great Wireworm (10:03, 10:09) and ice-imp (10:22, 12:54, 13:01, 14:33). 17-44-47 spent the charge on many steps with 5 or more enemies within 60, including 0:34 (93%, enemies_near 5), 1:02 (92%, 6), 1:07 (94%, 7), 1:13 (96%, 8), 2:02 (90%, 5), 2:10 (95%, 6), 3:17 (92%, 5) and 3:30 (91%, 5). See B45 for yes answers when neither condition held.

claim: A yes on that dash question follows the move already chosen, so during a chest walk it can carry Tibo into the crowd and can cost more hp than walking.
evidence: 17-18-06 dash 1:47 during chest approach still opened. 17-27 dash 79% at 2:23 on open-chest goal, channel still completed 2:27. 17-20-20 dash 78% at 1:14 and 96% at 1:20 went right while the chest goal was up-left; hp fell 108 to 76 and C65563 failed at 1:19. 17-44-47 dash 90% at 1:38 went up on the walked approach to a chest that was up; health 82 to 80 and the chest opened at 1:40.

claim: Amusing can deal a large hit that the one-second forecast prices as no damage, while Tibo stands still near the boss.
evidence: 17-03-58 31 hp at 3:05 on chest. 17-27 telegraph underfoot 2:02-2:18. 17-20-20 amusing dealt no listed damage. Wireworm and Mandoline showed the same forecast miss; see B36.

claim: A rise of about 30 hp with no food goal and no change in max hp can happen on nightmare world just after 3:00.
evidence: 17-03-58 51→81 at 3:14. 17-27 food-led +30 at 3:11. 17-20-20's clean non-food rises were at other times: +24 at 1:37, +29 at 1:38, +35 at 12:25, +34 at 12:49, +30 at 12:54, +46 at 13:20. The just-after-3:00 window is one place it can happen, not the only one. See B37.

claim: On nightmare open world, the E21 chest/food directive plus E24 dash can snowball into 15+ minute runs once chests evolve weapons, without further bot code changes.
evidence: 2026-11-07_17-09-06: 17:14, five evolved weapons. 17-27 died 3:39 before evolution. 17-20-20: 15:03, level 52, five evolutions by 8:16 (Factory Reset, Gravy Pack, Loaded Dice, Permafrost Fries, Sack of Russets), same directive and dash question, exploreDistance 600. Died to ice-imp, not before the evolutions.

claim: On long nightmare world crowd runs, enemy:ice-imp can become the top listed damage source.
evidence: 17-18-06: ice-imp 116 of 392 total; grease-fiend 75 second. 17-20-20: ice-imp 773 of 1179, the killing blow (169.1 in the last 3 seconds at 15:03). Big ticks were page walks at 10:56 (34), 13:47 (87) and 14:19 (114), enemies_near 0.

claim: When action.dash says no while standing_on shows a chest still charging, the model does not dash on those steps and the channel can complete if forecast allows stand/walk on tile.
evidence: 17-27-39 E30: 2:27 on chest 0.8/1 opened at 58 hp with walk only; no dash row on charging standing_on. 17-20-20: no dash row while standing_on showed a chest charging. Dashes at 1:14 and 1:20 were on the approach, before the tile. Step-offs at 1:38 and 3:12-3:24 were walks, and several of those channels still opened. 17-44-47: no dash row while standing on a charging chest; both channels opened (1:40, 1:41). The dash at 1:38 was on the approach. The charging window was about a second, so the question may not have been asked on the tile.

claim: On nightmare world, hp can rise about 24 to 46 with no food goal and no change in max hp, including before 3:00.
evidence: 17-20-20: +24 at 1:37 (67 to 91), +29 at 1:38 (87 to 116, max still 120, same second as the Factory Reset chest), +35 at 12:25 (139 to 173), +34 at 12:49 (94 to 129), +30 at 12:54, +46 at 13:20 (146 to 192). Outcome health gained about 1033, source unnamed. Gravy Heart level-ups that raised max hp (1:52, 3:31, 7:22, 8:46, 8:47) are a different event. 17-44-47 agrees: +24 at 2:45 (34 to 58) and +30 at 2:48 (58 to 88), max hp still 120, no food goal. The 2:48 row was inside a Stray Dog charged 0.2 of 1 second; the +24 was not. Outcome health gained about 58.

claim: Great Wireworm and The Mandoline can deal 56 to 82 hp on a step the one-second forecast prices as free.
evidence: 17-20-20 outcome: boss:great-wireworm 75, boss:the-mandoline 146. At 10:03 the worm was 18 away and the dash the model rated hurt 0.13 took 56.4. At 12:18 a page walk took 63.6 from the Mandoline 273 away. At 12:27 a page walk took 82.3 from the Mandoline 132 away. The action model was not asked on the two walks.

claim: At exploreDistance 600 a nightmare world seed can list a chest before 1:30 while hp is still high.
evidence: 17-20-20 seed 127B4T9: first chest row at 1:08, 40 and 54 away, hp 108/120, after four explore goals each walked 600 and found nothing. The 300-unit runs listed the first chest at 1:32, 1:46, 2:16, 2:20 and 3:02. One seed.

claim: On a full six-weapon six-passive build, planner.pick takes Skip over Sack of Gold and Baked Potato when hp is high, and takes Baked Potato when hp is lower.
Asked which shrine option makes Tibo strongest, the planner can take crit chance over a max HP raise while a boss is inside 100 units.
evidence: 17-20-20 at 10:02: crit chance 0% to 6% at 75%, max HP 192 to 215 at 19%, Great Wireworm 94 away at 93%. At 10:03 the worm hit for 56.4.

claim: A text-only E37 rule (no dash on open-chest approach when hurt_by totals 5+ in 3s) does not stop high-probability dashes on chest goals; the model still spends at 70%+ when hurt_by is present.
evidence: 17-33-44 E37: 2:49 dash 74% with blight-spore 8 in hurt_by; 2:54 89%/82% at 47 hp; hp 50→15 on first open.

claim: Hot oil underfoot during chest channel can top the killing blow when hp is already low after evolution picks.
evidence: 17-33-44: Hot oil in hurt_by 2:55 plan; die at 2:59 on chest 0.3s with bog-toad and blight-spore.

claim: While health is under 40%, a directive that forbids starting a Spud Whetstone keeps it off the goal: listed ones scored 5% to 9% and were never chosen.
evidence: 17-44-47, six listings, all under 40% health: 2:27 score 6% at 35 hp, 2:28 score 6% at 35 hp, 2:38 score 5% at 34 hp, 3:28 score 5% at 41 hp, 3:33 score 9% at 39 hp, 3:39 score 8% at 36 hp. None became the goal. The case of a listing at or above 40% hp did not occur.

claim: At exploreDistance 300 on nightmare world, the first Spud Whetstone can be listed only after health is already under 40%.
evidence: 17-44-47 seed Z40504. No Spud Whetstone in the goal options from 0:00 through 2:26, while health was still 49/120 at 2:14. First offer at 2:27 at 35 hp. After heals, health was above 40% from 2:45 (58 hp) to about 3:11 (55 hp) and no whetstone was offered. Next offer at 3:28 at 41 hp (34%). One seed.

claim: Listed food at about 210 units and beyond loses the goal vote to explore or evade under a chest-first directive, even when health is under 70%.
evidence: 17-44-47, five offers, zero food goals. 2:14: eat 41% vs evade 42%, food 257 away, 49 hp. 2:19: eat 36% vs evade 45%, food 228 away, 42 hp. 2:22: eat 35% vs explore 40%, food 293 away, 42 hp. 2:54: eat 19% vs evade 56%, food 212 away, 72 hp. 2:57: eat 17% vs explore 50%, food 316 away, 69 hp. No food inside 210 units was offered.

claim: When neither the dash yes-rules nor the dash no-rules match, action.dash can still answer yes, including at about 90% on a chest approach.
evidence: 17-44-47 at 1:38: dash 90% on an open-chest walk, enemies_near 3, crumb-ant 1.5 in the last 3 seconds. The chest still opened and the dash cost about 2 hp. At 2:57: dash 51% on an explore goal, enemies_near 1, amusing 2.2. One clear row and one borderline row.

claim: A sizzle-imp can deal about 20 hp on a step the one-second forecast prices at about 3 hp, and can be the killing blow on a short nightmare world run.
evidence: 17-44-47 outcome: sizzle-imp 66 of 170. At 3:43 health 36 to 14, hurt_by sizzle-imp 22.1, forecast on the chosen step -3 hp, hurt rating 2.47, 24 enemies within 60, other directions priced as death. Last 3 seconds: sizzle-imp 43.9 and sand-crab 4.3. Died at 3:44. One seed, Z40504.
